target_customer: Consumers wanting low-cost, always-on primary care guidance and physician visits
problem: Primary care is reactive and limited to short visits; Prana connects medical records and wearables to catch gradual decline and automates routine work so doctors focus on key decisions.
business_model: Consumer: free AI chat plus a flat $39 doctor visit with no subscription (per site)

founders.name: Meer Patel
education: Johns Hopkins, BS and MSE biomedical engineering
Deferred admission to Brown Medical School
founders.background_notes: Co-developed ICPredict, a brain pressure model, per the YC page.

founders.name: Vishvam Rawal
founders.background_notes: Quant research and algorithmic trading; built voice agents for medical billing.

founders.name: Sanjit Menon
education: Medical degree (profile says MD and graduating MD candidate in different places)
previous_startups: AI medical education platform with 400+ paying customers (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Clinical research publications per the YC page.

competitors.name: Doctronic
competitors.what: AI-native primary care with a free AI chat and a flat-fee $39 doctor visit
competitors.traction_then: Reported over 1 million unique users and about 50,000 weekly visits by one outlet
competitors.funding_then: $20M Series A led by Lightspeed, October 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating medical records and wearable data, LLM triage and physician workflow with clinical safety needs is demanding, but built on existing models and telehealth rails.

defensibility.rationale: Licensed physicians and state telehealth coverage add friction, but a funded rival already offered nearly the same free-chat plus $39 visit model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Doctronic scaled with a Series A in October 2025 and Counsel Health launched a white-label platform in July 2026. No acquisition of Prana found.

market_need_then: Consumers were already using AI health tools at scale in 2025, shown by Doctronic's reported 1 million users and $20M raise.

branding.domain_note: Uses pranadoc.com, adding 'doc' because the plain name is shared with many companies (for example Prana Health in North Carolina and Praan Health in India).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and reassuring, 'What can we help you with?'

brand_strength.rationale: A pleasant word with the Sanskrit sense of life force, but the company gives no origin, the name is widely shared, and there is no brand press.

outcome_analysis: Prana is a four-person W26 company with a mix of engineering, quant and clinical founders, live in beta with a free chat and $39 visits. Its model closely resembles Doctronic, which is better funded. No verified funding, shutdown or acquisition was found, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report $500K pre-seed (VCBacked) or $1M seed dated 2026-03-24 (Caplight), with Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund and Rebel Fund; Preqin lists undisclosed amount from YC and Pioneer Fund in March 2026. A Cigna 65 percent holding on Caplight is implausible and ignored. No company or press confirmation, so no round recorded. Confidence is medium because founders and competition are sourced.
